agent.problem: The wrong answer "The disciples have left her alone" is true in the passage: the disciples return to their homes while Mary remains outside the tomb (John 20:10-11). It is not what Mary tells the angels, but a wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not merely false as an answer to this question.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

agent.problem: Cards 11 and 12 set up Jesus' next word and then ask the baker to guess that exact word. Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out "Mary" rather than "Peace" or "Rise"; this asks for the next wording of His line instead of the movement or meaning of the passage.

rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
